name: Subject-Relative Camera Orientation
name_es: Orientación de cámara respecto al sujeto

camera_orientation.reference: Sides are anatomical sides of the subject. Camera moves relative to the subject, while the subject itself stays fixed.
camera_orientation.instruction: Place the camera at the selected viewing direction relative to the stationary subject. Do not rotate the subject to imitate a camera repositioning. Scene parallax may change when camera position changes.
